notes.title: Update Notes for 7/27
notes.content:
-Updated with proper keyboard controls
-Gamepad (specifically, XBox) support should work much better now, but let me know if it doesn't
-Various bug fixes and QOL updates

Please let me know if y'all have any questions or concerns about this new build!

-Skullpixl

notes.title: Happy Launch Day... Finally!
notes.content:
THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR PATIENCE!!! Hellworld is finally live and ready to play! Unfortunately I've already been alerted to a few bugs, so I'll be preparing a quick patch for the game tomorrow after work. 

Thanks again for all the support, I'd say Launch Day 2: Electric Boogaloo was a success!

-skullpixl

notes.title: Launching Soon - Sorry for the Delay!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Sorry for the radio silence on here, it's been a hot minute. The past two years have been pretty hectic, I was on dialysis for about a year and a half, got a kidney transplant, and took several months off to recover. The game itself is ready, however it remains in review for the time being. It was meant to release today, but I guess that's not happening yet! Keep an eye out though, if you have the game wishlisted you should get a notification when it's launched.

Again, sorry for the wait and the silence, life is pretty busy for me and I am only one person. I greatly appreciate your patience while I work through life and health things while simultaneously working on a game by myself.

Take care all, and keep your eyes peeled!

skullpixl

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys!!

Long time no update! The new opening animatic has been added (which is still in progress by the way, but it helps bring the story together), plus some new narration voice over! I've already been notified of some bugs in this new build, so if you encounter anything game-breaking, please hold the left and right bumper on your controller and press select to reset whatever level you are on. If that doesn't fix the problem please please PLEASE let me know so I can investigate and fix!!

Much love,
-skullpixl

notes.title: Quick Demo Patch
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I've read and listened to all your feedback and did some small updates to the demo. Nothing too big, just some small animation updates and bug fixes. As always, if you come across anything game-breaking, please let me know!!

-skullpixl

notes.title: Hellworld! Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey all! Thanks for being so patient with me while I get the demo uploaded. There are a few issues I'd like to address:

1) Currently there are no keyboard controls available for this demo, it's gamepad only. This will change soon, as I am currently working on implementing keyboard controls within the week.

2) There are several sound effects and voice lines that have no yet been added! I will make an announcement here once the current build has been updated.

3) If you come across any bugs or other issues while playing, please let me know! This game is very obviously a work in progress and thus I am very open to feedback, suggestions, etc.

Thanks for reading!!

skullpixl
